verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only ways for external AI tools to reach Anytype: a local API, an official MCP server, and an agents skill dropped into Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools. These are integration building blocks, not a built-in assistant that users delegate tasks to inside the app. The GitHub mention of AI "Agents" (see AGENTS.md) does not describe an in-app assistant, and no other evidence documents one.
